ex.s: The Disruptor forces change; the clean-up is somebody else’s problem.
ex.t: 这种态度最好概括为"快速行动，打破常规"。

ex.s: She has served here for 17 years and can’t imagine working anywhere else.
ex.t: 她在这里工作17年了，无法想象去别的地方工作。

ex.s: The best way to ease pressure on over-touristed destinations is to go somewhere else.
ex.t: 缓解游客过多目的地压力的最好办法，是去别的地方。

ex.s: Travel for you and no one else.
ex.t: 为自己、而不是为别人而旅行。

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.

ex.s: The notion that we live in someone else’s video game is irresistible to many.
ex.t: 我们生活在别人电子游戏中的想法对许多人来说很有吸引力。

ex.s: Skilled at putting up shelves and piecing together furniture, she never pays someone else to do a job she can do herself.
ex.t: 她擅长安装架子和拼装家具，从不花钱请别人做自己能做的事。

ex.s: You’ll work harder if you train with someone else.
ex.t: 如果和别人一起训练，你会更努力。

ex.s: The technology could determine whether a driver had just texted, emailed or done anything else that is not allowed under New York's hands-free driving laws.

ex.s: Klein writes, "America did not invent the steam engine, but once they grasped its passwords they put it to more uses than anyone else. "
ex.t: Klein写道："美国人没有发明蒸汽机，但一旦他们掌握了它的奥秘，它的用途就比任何人都多。"

ex.s: I’m certainly not going to advise my friend or anyone else to invest in quantum computers.
ex.t: 我当然不会建议我的朋友或任何人投资量子计算机。

ex.s: When a plane is leaving in 15 minutes and the door is closing, what else can we suggest but: “Run!

ex.s: In looking into the stories of biological discovery, I also began to find something else, a collection of scientists, usually brilliant occasionally half-mad, who made the discoveries.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉也开始填满了，当它填满时我在想是否还有更大的发现，不仅仅是物种，还有依赖于被认为无用的东西的生命，甚至是没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: Now I think of her as reading so much of the time while doing something else.
ex.t: 现在我想象她一边做别的事，一边大部分时间都在阅读。

ex.s: My immediate reaction was to assume I was listening to someone else's recording.
ex.t: 我的第一反应是以为我在听别人的录音。

ex.s: As any younger brother will tell you, having a big brother involves a lot of walking in someone else's shadow, especially when you have a brother who is a typical example of "cool".
ex.t: 正如任何弟弟会告诉你的那样，拥有一个大哥哥涉及很多在别人的阴影下行走，特别是当你有一个哥哥是"酷"的典型例子时。

ex.s: I didn't feel as though I needed to keep up with anybody else; I was finally with peers who understood me.
ex.t: 我感觉不需要跟上任何人；我终于和懂我的同龄人在一起了。

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点，他相信GI带来的最重风险并非来自对全人类的背叛，而是来自于以牺牲其他一切为代价，对既定目标的顽强追求。

ex.s: There was a bit of me that didn't want to love this when everyone else on the planet did but the horror story is brilliant.
ex.t: 当地球上其他人都喜爱这本书时，我心里有一点不想爱上它，但这本恐怖小说太精彩了。

ex.s: Dance expresses love and hate, joy and sorrow, life and death, and everything else in between.
ex.t: 舞蹈表达爱与恨、喜与悲、生与死，以及其间的一切。

ex.t: “我无法想象在生活中做其他任何事情。”布里奇斯为所有年龄段的人开设舞蹈课。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。
